note: Max rank only. The simulator runs at level 60, and a talent tooltip shows rank 1 of the ability it grants -- see docs/class-implementation.md.

spells.name: Adrenaline Rush
spells.description: Increases your Energy regeneration rate by 100% for 15 sec.

spells.name: Ambush
spells.description: Ambush the target, causing 250% weapon damage plus 290 to the target. Must be stealthed and behind the target. Requires a dagger in the main hand. Awards 1 combo point.

spells.name: Backstab
spells.description: Backstab the target, causing 150% weapon damage plus 225 to the target. Must be behind the target. Requires a dagger in the main hand. Awards 1 combo point.

spells.name: Blade Flurry
spells.description: Increases your melee attack speed by 20% and your melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent. Lasts 15 sec.

spells.name: Blind
spells.description: Blinds the target, causing it to wander disoriented for up to 10 sec. Any damage caused will remove the effect.

spells.name: Blinding Powder
spells.description: Create the reagent for the Blind ability.

spells.name: Cheap Shot
spells.description: Stuns the target for 4 sec. Must be stealthed. Awards 2 combo points.

spells.name: Cold Blood
spells.description: When activated, increases the critical strike chance of your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Eviscerate, or Mutilate by 100%.

spells.name: Crippling Poison
spells.description: Coats a weapon with poison that lasts for 30 minutes. Each strike has a 30% chance of poisoning the enemy, slowing their movement speed by 70% for 12 sec.

spells.name: Deadly Poison
spells.description: Coats a weapon with poison that lasts for 30 minutes. Each strike has a 30% chance of poisoning the enemy for 92 Nature damage over 12 sec. Stacks up to 5 times on a single target. 180 charges.

spells.name: Detect Traps
spells.description: Greatly increased chance to detect traps.

spells.name: Disarm Trap
spells.description: Sneak up on the trap in order to disarm it. Don't get too close or the trap will go off.

spells.name: Distract
spells.description: Throws a distraction, attracting the attention of all nearby enemies and reducing their Stealth detection as if they were 1 level lower for 10 seconds. Does not break stealth.

spells.name: Evasion
spells.description: The rogue's dodge chance will increase by 50% for 15 sec.

spells.name: Eviscerate
spells.description:
Finishing move that causes damage per combo point, increased by Attack Power:
 1 point : 224-332 damage
 2 points: 394-502 damage
 3 points: 564-672 damage
 4 points: 734-842 damage
 5 points: 904-1,012 damage

spells.name: Expose Armor
spells.description:
Finishing move that exposes the target for 30 sec, reducing armor per combo point:
 1 point : 450 armor
 2 points: 900 armor
 3 points: 1,350 armor
 4 points: 1,800 armor
 5 points: 2,250 armor

spells.name: Feint
spells.description: Performs a feint, causing no damage but lowering your threat by a large amount, making the enemy less likely to attack you.

spells.name: Garrote
spells.description: Garrote the enemy, causing 552 damage over 18 sec, increased by your Attack Power. Must be stealthed and behind the target. Awards 1 combo point.

spells.name: Ghostly Strike
spells.description: A strike that deals 125% (180% if a Dagger is equipped in your Main Hand) weapon damage and increases your chance to dodge by 15% for 7 sec. Awards 1 combo point.

spells.name: Gouge
spells.description: Causes 75 damage, stops your attack, and incapacitates the target for 4 sec. The target must be facing you. Any damage taken will break the effect. Awards 1 combo point.

spells.name: Hemorrhage
spells.description: An instant strike that deals 100% weapon damage (145% if a Dagger is equipped) and causes the target to take 15% increased Rupture damage from the Rogue. Lasts 15 sec. Awards 1 Combo Point.

spells.name: Instant Poison
spells.description: Coats a weapon with poison that lasts for 30 minutes. Each strike has a 20% chance of poisoning the enemy which instantly inflicts 76 to 100 Nature damage. 175 charges.

spells.name: Kick
spells.description: A quick kick that injures a single foe for 80 damage. It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 5 sec.

spells.name: Kidney Shot
spells.description:
Finishing move that stuns the target. Lasts longer per combo point:
 1 point : 2 seconds
 2 points: 3 seconds
 3 points: 4 seconds
 4 points: 5 seconds
 5 points: 6 seconds

spells.name: Mind-numbing Poison
spells.description: Coats a weapon with poison that lasts for 30 minutes. Each strike has a 20% chance of poisoning the enemy, increasing their casting time by 60% for 14 sec. 150 charges.

spells.name: Mutilate
spells.description: Instantly attacks with both weapons for 75% weapon damage plus an additional 38 with each weapon. Damage increased by 20% against Poisoned targets. Awards 2 Combo Points.

spells.name: Pick Pocket
spells.description: Pick the target's pocket.

spells.name: Premeditation
spells.description: Adds 2 Combo Points to your target. You must add to or use those combo points within 20 sec or the combo points are lost.

spells.name: Preparation
spells.description: When activated, this ability immediately finishes the cooldown on your other Rogue abilities.

spells.name: Riposte
spells.description: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 150% weapon damage and disarms the target for 6 sec.

spells.name: Rupture
spells.description:
Finishing move that causes damage over time, increased by your Attack Power. Lasts longer per combo point:
 1 point : 159 damage over 8 secs
 2 points: 222 damage over 10 secs
 3 points: 295 damage over 12 secs
 4 points: 377 damage over 14 secs
 5 points: 469 damage over 16 secs

spells.name: Safe Fall
spells.description: Reduces damage from falling.

spells.name: Sap
spells.description: Incapacitates the target for up to 45 sec. Only works on Humanoids that are not in combat. Any damage taken will break the effect. Only 1 target may be sapped at a time. Does not break Stealth.

spells.name: Sinister Strike
spells.description: An instant strike that causes 68 damage in addition to your normal weapon damage. Awards 1 combo point.

spells.name: Slice and Dice
spells.description:
Finishing move that increases melee attack speed by 30%. Lasts longer per combo point:
 1 point : 9 seconds
 2 points: 12 seconds
 3 points: 15 seconds
 4 points: 18 seconds
 5 points: 21 seconds

spells.name: Sprint
spells.description: Increases the rogue's movement speed by 70% for 15 sec. Does not break stealth.

spells.name: Stealth
spells.description: Allows the rogue to sneak around, but reduces your speed by 30%. Lasts until cancelled.

spells.name: Vanish
spells.description: Allows the rogue to vanish from sight, entering an improved stealth mode for 10 sec. Also breaks movement impairing effects. More effective than Vanish (Rank 1).

spells.name: Venom
spells.description:
Finishing move that increases the damage of your Poisons by 30% and your chance to apply Poisons by 10%. Lasts longer per combo point:
 1 point : 9 seconds
 2 points: 12 seconds
 3 points: 15 seconds
 4 points: 18 seconds
 5 points: 21 seconds

spells.name: Wound Poison
spells.description: Coats a weapon with poison that lasts for 30 minutes. Each strike has a 30% chance of poisoning the enemy, reducing all healing effects used on them by 165 for 15 sec. Stacks up to 5 times on a single target. 160 charges.
